name: Independent insurance brokers (category guide)
summary: Fee vs commission brokers — comparing inpatient riders without a single-insurer sales script, and documents to demand before you bind.
body: Tied agents sell one brand; independent brokers / FA firms can compare multiple insurers — still ask how they are paid (commission vs client fee) and get product illustrations in writing. Expats shopping hospitalisation, outpatient riders, and maternity add-ons should compare waiting periods, ward pro-ration, pre-existing exclusions, and panel hospital lists — not brochure gifts. Cross-check MAS Register of Representatives and keep emails of advice given. Distinct from insurer brand pages (AIA/Prudential-style listings) and from the private-health-insurance category overview. Category guide, not a ranked broker league table.
whenToEngage: Want multi-insurer compare without a tied-agent script
Need written waiting periods / exclusions before binding
Maternity / outpatient rider shopping across brands
Unsure commission vs fee conflict on advice
